Golf Outing

Scottsdale Sprinters runs chauffeured golf outing transportation across Scottsdale and metro Phoenix. This page is the golf-day runbook: one vehicle sized for players and club bags, hotel or Airbnb pickup, transfer timed to a confirmed tee time, optional post-round stop, and a planned return. Bookings are hourly charters so wait and staging can sit inside the window you buy. For seats, bag-capacity tables, and live hourly floors, use the golf outing Sprinter van service page and confirm totals in live checkout — this experience page does not republish rate tables.

Request a quoteCall to reserve

Prices start at $125 an hour for the Luxury SUV (Suburban), which seats 6, on a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $500 before 8% tax. Every vehicle is booked by the hour at its published rate and minimum, with no per-seat pricing.

About this experience

Plan hotel pickup, course arrival, club storage, and the post-round stop around one vehicle sized for both players and gear.

  • Club and bag loading. Golf-bag capacity varies by vehicle and how many passengers ride with the clubs. Fit is confirmed before booking once you share player count, bag count, and any extra luggage. Do not assume bags equal seats.
  • Course transfers. Submit the exact course address and tee time. Pickup and drop points follow the course's posted rules and the addresses on your reservation — many clubs separate player drop from parking.
  • 19th-hole / post-round stop. A confirmed dinner, clubhouse, or other venue can sit inside the same hourly window when listed on the reservation.
  • Multi-course days. Both tee times, bag count, any meal stop, and the return window go in the request so route feasibility can be reviewed.
  • Tournament transportation requests. For WM Phoenix Open week product detail, see the WM Phoenix Open experience. Plain-round golf days stay on this page and the golf service page.
  • Cargo needs in writing. Club bags, cooler soft goods, and other cargo should be listed before pickup so the assigned vehicle is the right one.

Itinerary

  4. Post-round stop at a confirmed venue

What this experience covers

A chauffeured golf day typically includes pickup at a hotel, resort, or residence; club and bag loading confirmed before departure; a course transfer timed around your confirmed tee time; optional post-round venue stops inside the booked window; and a return to the same or a second address. Share the exact course address, tee time, player count, and club-bag count when you request service so vehicle fit and the transportation window can be reviewed in writing before anything is charged. Rates are priced by the hour on a published minimum — see the golf service page and live checkout for current figures.

Example itinerary

  1. Morning pickup with club loading. Designate a bag lead; count bags separately from seats. Load at the hotel curb or residence driveway noted on the confirmation.
  2. Transfer to the golf course. Build an arrival buffer before tee — ask reservations what buffer fits your course and vehicle. Drop at the course's allowed curb or bag-drop area as instructed in writing.
  3. Service window aligned with the confirmed tee time. Hourly charter covers staging and wait when those minutes sit inside the bought window and the confirmation.
  4. Post-round stop at a confirmed venue. Add the address when you book so the chauffeur is not improvising the 19th hole.
  5. Optional second round or dinner. Multi-stop days need every address and timing note on the reservation.
  6. Return to hotel. One planned return address keeps the group together after the round.

Clubs, bags, and vehicle fit

Share players, club bags, and other luggage so Scottsdale Sprinters can confirm fit before booking. Seat and bag planning details live on the Scottsdale golf outing transportation service page — confirm the assigned vehicle in writing. As a qualitative guide only (no invented bag counts): executive Sprinters are the usual choice when bags dominate the daytime cabin; party-oriented units fit better when the same group turns the evening into nightlife. Compare executive Sprinter fleet and Sprinter van rental for cabin style, then lock numbers on the golf service page.

Bag drop and course curb notes

Pickup and drop locations follow the course's posted rules and the addresses on your reservation. Many clubs separate player drop from parking — tell reservations the course name and requested arrival time so the confirmation can reflect the allowed curb.

Multi-course and corporate outing notes

A multi-course day can be requested when both tee times, bag count, meal stop, and return window are clear. Corporate or client outings that need invoice language, multiple vehicles, or shotgun-wave timing should also review the golf service "corporate and tournament" framing and, when the product is Open week, the WM Phoenix Open experience. For broader B2B coordination, see corporate transportation.

Frequently asked questions

Can you fit all our golf clubs?

Golf-bag capacity varies by vehicle and passenger count. Share the exact number of players, club bags, and other luggage so Scottsdale Sprinters can confirm fit before booking. Seat and bag planning details live on the Scottsdale golf transportation service page — confirm the assigned vehicle in writing.

Which courses do you recommend?

Scottsdale Sprinters does not book tee times. Choose and book the course directly, then submit its exact address, tee time, player count, and club-bag count. The team reviews vehicle fit, loading access, and the transportation window before confirming the route.

Can we do a multi-course day?

A multi-course day can be requested. Share both confirmed tee times, club-bag count, any meal stop, and the return window so route feasibility and vehicle fit can be reviewed and confirmed in writing.

What does Scottsdale golf outing transportation include?

A chauffeured vehicle sized for your player count and bags, hotel or residence pickup, transfer timed around your confirmed tee time, optional post-round stops inside the booked window, and a planned return. Hourly floors and bag capacity tables are on the golf service page; confirm totals in live checkout.

Can one booking cover golf and a night out?

Often yes on an hourly charter when the schedule fits one service window. Share tee time, dinner or nightlife stops, and return address up front. Compare the golf, bachelor, and nightlife service pages, then confirm the window in writing.
